labs.note: The LDH list marks it "(PRIVATE WELLS ONLY)". Its own site (fetched 2026-11-16) says it takes bacteria samples Monday-Friday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM, results in 24 to 36 hours, payment in advance; certified results (accepted for FHA, VA, HUD, Rural Development, conventional loans and real estate closings) are $145.00 for a routine bacteria test in St. Tammany Parish and $95.00 for a repeat, with a mileage charge outside St. Tammany; non-certified results are $95.00.
